boundary: Finite equitable-partition coarse graining only; no continuum RG fixed point, field-theory beta function, emergent spacetime or universality-class claim.
interpretation: This is an exact finite coarse-to-fine renormalization/intertwining hierarchy for adjacency-polynomial propagation and the componentwise cubic nonlinear model.
nonlinear_closure: Because each refinement lift has exactly one 1 per row, (R x)^{\circ 3}=R(x^{\circ 3}). Therefore the cubic selector vector field restricted to each coarse fixed space lifts exactly into every finer fixed space.
polynomial_closure: For every polynomial p, p(Q6)R63=R63 p(Q3) and p(Q8)R86=R86 p(Q6).
